contacting-through-astral-contacts-rando.npc: INTRUDER! Red alert! Batten down the hatches! DIVE, DIVE, DIVE!

contacting-through-astral-contacts-rando.player: Err, maybe I'll call back later.

contacting-through-astral-contacts-rando.npc: The fish cannot ride the gravy train.
The cyclops cannot see his inner walrus?
Waddle into a sunset of flaking mackerel?
The sardine is leaving the tin?

removing-the-clockwork-suit-at-the-base-.text: A KGP Agent appears next to the player.

removing-the-clockwork-suit-at-the-base-.npc: There's been a breach! Red alert!

removing-the-clockwork-suit-at-the-base-.text: The KGP thinks you are a threat.
The screen fades to black, and the player is taken back near Larry and the boat. The player is kneeling face down in the snow, stunned.

removing-the-clockwork-suit-at-the-base-.npc: Phew, that was a close call.
